xsdSchema.title: XSD schema
xsdSchema.description: XML schema used for request payload validation

resourceName.title: Resource name
resourceName.description: Name of the schema registry resource configured on this API

schemaMapping.title: Schema subject / ID
schemaMapping.description: Schema subject or ID to fetch from the registry. Use a literal value (e.g. 'order-v1') or an EL expression (e.g. {#request.headers['X-Schema-Subject'][0]}).

registryUrl.title: Registry URL
registryUrl.description: Base URL of the Confluent-compatible registry, e.g. http://localhost:8080/apis/ccompat/v7

schemaSubject.title: Schema subject
schemaSubject.description: Subject name registered in the registry, e.g. order-schema

errorMessage.title: Http error message
errorMessage.description: Http error message to send when request is not valid. Status code is 400 for invalid payload and 500 for schema resolution or XSD errors. Supports EL.
